people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.
translations.bsb: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought Him, and He was found by them.
translations.kjv: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
translations.asv: But when in their distress they turned unto Jehovah, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
